ltv_slabs._note: slab based on PROPERTY VALUE; % is max loan of that value. Boundaries: <=30L, 30-75L, >75L. Matches RBI standard.
ltv_slabs._source: ICICI blog - actual cost of buying a house (icici.bank.in)

max_tenure_years._note: Max 30 years, subject to max age at maturity limits

retirement_age._note: Max age at maturity: 65 salaried, 70 self-employed. DIFFERS from HDFC (60/65) - ICICI allows older borrowers longer tenure = higher eligibility for older applicants.

processing_fee._note: 0.5% of loan amount for standard home loans (per rate page). Service-charges page states 'up to 2%' as ceiling - 0.5% is the actual home-loan rate. Other charges (legal, admin, valuation, prepayment) exist - deferred to full fee-schedule layer.
processing_fee._source: ICICI home loan interest rate page (icici.bank.in)

rate_band._note: CONTRADICTORY SOURCE (2026-08-05): headline says 'Aug 2026 from 7.50%' but standard rate table says 'valid till 31 July 2026, 8.50-9.80%'. Table appears un-refreshed. Emailed ICICI for clarification. MUST re-verify. Repo-linked.
rate_band._source: ICICI home loan interest rate page (icici.bank.in) - internally inconsistent dates

foir_by_income_band._note: FOIR cap varies by income - proprietary, DSA-gated

salaried: Latest month salary slip (or appointment letter)
3 months bank statement (waived for ICICI account holders)
other income proofs if any (rental, dividend, interest)
self_employed_professional: Balance sheet, P&L, computation of income, audit report (CA cert only for audited financials)
self_employed_non_professional: 3 years ITR with computation of income
3 years CA-certified/audited balance sheet and P&L
accepted_income_proofs._note: ICICI splits self-employed into professional vs non-professional (HDFC does too). Real differences from HDFC: ICICI salaried needs only 1 month slip + 3 months statement (HDFC wanted 3 slips + 6 months); ICICI waives statement for its own account holders; ICICI non-professional needs 3 years ITR+financials vs 2.

co_applicant_clubbing._note: Key remediation lever for FOIR-bound buyers. Clubbing spouse/parent income raises FOIR base. Haircut % and allowed relationships are lender-specific - DSA-gated.
